title: London
about: Beyond Portugal: London, the first place outside Portugal (Dinis, 18 November 2026). sentences.text: The Environment Agency lists 2 flood warnings and alerts for the London area.
The Upper River Colne and Radlett Brook warning is no longer in force.
The Lower Lee tributaries warning is also no longer in force.
Today, 2026-11-19, the forecast for London is a minimum of 7.2 °C, a maximum of 10.6 °C and 6.5 mm of rain.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-20, the forecast for London is a minimum of 6.9 °C, a maximum of 10.2 °C and 1.1 mm of rain.
The Environment Agency's flood data, last read at 2026-11-19 10:04 UTC, covers 10 stations and 10 rain gauges.
TfL JamCams lists 889 London traffic cameras, last read at 2026-11-19 10:09 UTC.
